subject: Re: Pickup quote 93721 Regensburg to MUC on 2026-11-26
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for reaching out! We can collect your shipment in Regensburg and deliver it to the air export warehouse at MUC. Our all-in price is 236.20 EUR, and the pickup time is 6 hours.

The quote is valid until 21 Nov 2026 19:00 UTC. Your offer reference is TRK-3213, and there’s no need to book the pickup.

Best regards,
Flinkwagen Logistik
